title: James Palmer: How do the Broncos adjust for Jaguars after a rough week 1? | Orange & Blue Today
text: Amazon Prime NFL Insider James Palmer joins Andrew Mason and Cecil Lammey on Orange & Blue Today to break down the Broncos’ Week 2 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars — and how Denver responds after a wake‑up call against the Chiefs. The Broncos couldn’t slow down Kenneth Walker in Week 1, and now they face another high‑powered offense with multiple ways to stress a defense. How big of a concern is Denver’s run defense moving forward, and what has to change immediately to avoid a repeat performance. On offense, the Broncos need to find rhythm after struggling to run the ball consistently. JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey looked good on limited touches — so can Davis Webb get them involved earlier, or does Sean Payton need to step in and help stabilize the play‑calling. And then there’s Trevor Lawrence, who can test tight windows and challenge Denver’s coverage rules. Palmer breaks down how Jacksonville will attack, what matchups matter most, and how the Broncos can keep this game from tilting early. 🔥 In this episode: How Denver responds after the Chiefs wake‑up call Why the Jaguars’ offense is a major test for the Broncos How Dobbins and Harvey fit into the Week 2 gameplan Whether Sean Payton steps in on play‑calling How Trevor Lawrence stresses Denver’s coverage Drop your Week 2 take — what’s the biggest adjustment Denver must make before Sunday.

title: What does Chiefs loss tells us about Broncos run D, play‑calling, & Bo Nix? | Orange & Blue Today
text: Cec and Mase break down everything that went wrong for the Broncos in their 31–10 loss to the Chiefs on Monday Night Football — and what it means moving forward. Denver couldn’t slow down Kenneth Walker, who ripped through the defense all night. Missed tackles, poor fits, and bad angles made it easy for Kansas City to control the game. So how big of a concern is this going forward, especially with more quality running backs on the schedule. On offense, the Broncos failed to run the ball consistently, even though JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey looked good on limited touches. Can Davis Webb get them involved earlier, or will Sean Payton have to step in and help with play‑calling. And then there’s Bo Nix, who struggled under constant pressure. Cec and Mase dig into how Denver can better protect him, what adjustments are realistic, and how the offense can stabilize before Week 2. 🔥 In this episode: How Denver’s run defense became a major concern Why Dobbins and Harvey need more early involvement Whether Sean Payton steps in on play‑calling How the Broncos can better protect Bo Nix What Monday night revealed about Denver’s identity Drop your take — what’s the biggest fix Denver needs before Week 2.

title: NFL Week 2 Preview: Josh Allen, Joe Burrow, Lamar Jackson headline the Top 5 in Power Rankings + Best Bets, Fantasy Sleepers & more!

text: Hoge & Jahns are live as they break down what happened in the Bears’ historic Week 1 win and what comes next for Chicago. title: [FULL EPISODE] Bears shift their attention to the Vikings
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: The focus up at Halas Hall has shifted to the Vikings, the Bears opponent in Week 2. Of course, Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote are still marveling at that 59-point explosion by the Bears offense against the Panthers. What more can we expect against the Vikings? It will be a different test, as Vikings defense coordinator Brian Flores has a tough scheme to diagnose. How is Bears head coach Ben Johnson preparing for that test? Also in this episode, Hall of Fame quarterback Kurt Warner had interesting perspective about grading quarterbacks after Pro Football Focus didn't have the best grade for quarterback Caleb Williams' performance against Carolina.

title: Ben Johnson vs. Brian Flores going to be awesome

title: [FULL EPISODE] The Athletic's Alec Lewis gives us a look at the Vikings!
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: As we turn the page to Week 2, Dan Wiederer is joined by Alec Lewis, who covers the Vikings for The Athletic. The guys reflect on the Bears and Vikings both earning wins in Week 1 before turning their attention to the marquee matchup of Chicago head coach Ben Johnson's explosive offense against Minnesota defensive coordinator Brian Flores' dangerous unit. Which coach will gain the edge in this game? Also, what's going on with the Vikings' quarterback situation?
